title: Successful Stripe payment
description: PaymentIntent created, charge succeeded, PaymentIntent succeeded. Includes embedded customer and card fields that PandaPayLens hides.

title: Stripe: insufficient funds
description: A card_error API response with decline_code insufficient_funds.

title: Stripe: authentication required
description: A PaymentIntent that needs 3D Secure, with the off-session decline that triggered it.

title: Stripe: duplicate webhook delivery
description: The same event delivered twice, with receipt timestamps.

title: Stripe: events arriving out of order
description: payment_intent.succeeded arrives before the events that preceded it.

title: Adyen: successful authorisation
description: A Standard webhook AUTHORISATION with success=true. The reason field with card summary is dropped.

title: Adyen: declined authorisation
description: A Refused payment response and the matching AUTHORISATION webhook (Not enough balance).

title: Adyen: authorisation, capture and refund
description: Modifications linked to the payment through originalReference.

title: Unknown provider error
description: An error from an unsupported source. PandaPayLens explains that it cannot analyze it.

title: Mixed, unrelated transactions
description: Stripe and Adyen events for separate payments, kept apart in separate groups.

title: Adyen: duplicate and conflicting webhooks
description: A repeated AUTHORISATION and a CAPTURE delivered with both success=false and success=true.

title: Adyen: possible duplicate charge
description: Two authorised payments for one merchantReference around an internal error.

title: Stripe: api_error with unknown outcome
description: An error that does not say whether the request took effect.

title: Stripe: state change after success
description: A PaymentIntent reported as processing after it had succeeded.

title: payabl.: authorized order notification
description: A form-encoded order notification for a successful authorization.

title: payabl.: declined, insufficient funds
description: A form-encoded Gateway API response for an issuer decline.

title: payabl.: timeout with unknown outcome
description: A Gateway API response where the result of the request is not known.

title: Checkout.com: declined payment
description: A 201 response with approved=false, decoded from response_code.

title: Checkout.com: capture and refund webhooks
description: Gateway webhooks linked through the pay_ payment id and act_ action ids.

title: PayPal: order completed, capture declined
description: An order with status COMPLETED whose capture was declined. The order status is not the payment outcome.

title: PayPal: INSTRUMENT_DECLINED
description: An Orders v2 error with a details[].issue value.

title: PayPal: order and capture webhooks
description: Webhook events for one order, correlated through related_ids.

title: Mollie: failed payment
description: A payment snapshot with status failed and a failureReason.

title: Mollie: authorized, captured and refunded
description: Payment, capture and refund objects linked by their ids.

title: Mollie: classic webhook (id only)
description: A classic webhook carries only the payment id. PandaPayLens explains what else is needed.

title: Square: declined card payment
description: An error response that includes the FAILED payment.

title: Square: payment and refund webhooks
description: payment.* and refund.* events grouped by payment id.

title: Braintree: processor declined
description: A GraphQL response where the decline is a transaction in data, not an error.

title: Braintree: sale, refund and dispute
description: Transaction snapshots linked by transaction and refund ids, built from status history.

title: Braintree: signed webhook (not decodable)
description: A raw bt_signature/bt_payload webhook. PandaPayLens explains what to paste instead.
